FastPFor provenance
===================

Source: pyfastpfor 1.4.0 source distribution from PyPI
URL: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/4a/f0/967992e77c1818044f3791b5737472e42d2eefa33162559e37427eddcc73/pyfastpfor-1.4.0.tar.gz
PyFastPFor repository: https://github.com/searchivarius/PyFastPFor
Matching inspected PyFastPFor commit: 690a7e603fddec687712e8f1f17a8e5e20eb5292

The `headers/` and `src/` directories are copied from the bundled `fastpfor/`
tree in the pyfastpfor 1.4.0 source distribution, because that is the source
used to build pyfastpfor 1.4.0. The GitHub repository has no v1.4.0 tag and no
FastPFor submodule metadata to resolve; its current library files match this
sdist, apart from benchmark/test sources omitted from the sdist.

Vendored for byte-exact `simdfastpfor256` parity with pyfastpfor 1.4.0.
Do not edit vendored files directly.
